messages.body_plain:
BioBash Free: Uvod v Python za biologe
3-urna brezplačna delavnica
Torek, 16.6.2015, 17:30 - 20:30
Poligon, Tobačna ulica 5, 1000 Ljubljana

Brezplačna delavnica je namenjena študentom in raziskovalcem s področja ved o življenju, ki jih zanima programiranje v računalniškem jeziku Python in želijo nekaj pomoči pri prvih korakih (predznanje programiranja ni potrebno). Na delavnici se boste naučili osnovne logike programskih jezikov z uporabo skriptnega jezika Python, ki je prijazen za učenje in med najbolj uporabljanimi jeziki v različnih znanstvenih disciplinah, tudi v binformatiki (http://www.nature.com/news/programming-pick-up-python-1.16833).

Cilj delavnice je razviti enostaven program (skripto) in se na tej poti poučiti o spremenljivkah, osnovnih podatkovnih tipih (string, integer, boolean), načinih usmerjanja programa (if/else) in uporabe zank (for) za avtomatiziranje ponavljajočih procesov.

Za lažje sledenje na delavnici si lahko vnaprej namestite programski jezik Python (verzijo 2.7: https://www.python.org/downloads/), saj bo večino časa namenjenega samostojnemu reševanju nalog.

Opremljeni s tem znanjem boste lahko naprej razvijali veščine programiranja samostojno ali s poglobljenimi specializiranimi tečaji. Torej – če si mislite, da bi se bilo dobro priučiti osnov programiranja, pa ne veste, kje začeti, potem se nam pridružite.

Več informacij:
BioBash Free (https://www.biobash.com/biobash-free-uvod-v-python-za-biologe/)
FB dogodek (https://www.facebook.com/events/898017453604601/)

messages.subject: Poletna šola bioinformatike
messages.body_plain:
Pozdravljeni, raziskovalci in študenti!

BioBash poletna šola je nemenjena biologom, ki šele vstopajo v svet bioinformatike. Podana bodo osnovna znanja Linux ukazne vrstice in R. Večina delavnice bo usmerjena v študij programskega jezika Python, ki bo prišel prav vsakmur, ki dela s podatki, ne glede na raziskovalno področje. Tekom delavnice bo vsak udeleženec delal na svojem problemu, s čemer bomo neposredno prenašali osvojena znanja v prakso.

Datum: 7. do 11. september 2015
Lokacija: Ljubljana, Slovenija

From: Joshua Browning <joshua....@fao.org>
Date: Thu, May 28, 2015 at 3:17 PM
Subject: [R-jobs] Statistician for The Food and Agriculture Organization of the UN in Rome, Italy
To: r-sig...@r-project.org

Job Description:

The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations based in
Rome is seeking a talented statistician to join the Statistics division.

We value people with technical skills, and in particular individuals who
are able to translate numbers to actions and to make an impact on the world.

In this role, you will be:
-€“ Developing R methods in collaboration with FAO statisticians from
various domains (Fisheries, Forestry, Agriculture)
-€“ Devising and applying test cases for those methods
-€“ Developing R code that adheres to FAO R coding standards
-€“ Integrating R packages to the in-house analytical system

The ideal candidate will have the following background and skills:
-€“ A graduate degree in Statistics, Mathematics or Science-related
discipline with a strong emphasis in quantitative applications,
experience or knowledge of imputation methodology is a plus.
-€“ 3+ years of professional experience with proven achievements
resulting from analyses.
-€“ Extensive and all around knowledge of R.
-€“ High degree of self-motivation.
-€“ Comfortable with databases.
-€“ Strong ability to communicate theories and results.

Nice to have:
-€“ Experience with agriculture or trade statistics.
-€“ Knowledge of agriculture, poverty or rural development.
-€“ Experience with tools for reproducibility
(https://github.com/jtleek/rpackages)
-€“ Creative data visualization.
-€“ Machine learning, spatial analysis, NLP, network analysis, etc.

How to apply:
If you are interested in this opportunity, please respond privately
tojoshua...@fao.orgwith you CV and any relevant material such as
codes snippets on Github.

--
Joshua Browning
Statistician

Viale delle Terme di Caracalla, 00153 Rome, Italy
Tel: +39 06 570 55142
